title: Company profile

about.heading: Company background
about.body: Oceanides coordinates property services for homes, condominiums and company facilities. We connect site findings with an agreed scope of work, a written quotation and the appropriate field team or specialist contractor.
about.support: From the first inquiry to turnover, Oceanides remains your main contact for scheduling, site access and service coordination.

history.heading: Established in 2021
history.body: Oceanides began in 2021 with septic tank cleaning and plumbing services. Today, its offering brings together five service groups to support the care and upkeep of homes and facilities.

stages.label: Today
stages.title: A broader property service offering
stages.detail: Siphoning, plumbing, renovation and restoration, pest control, and STP projects.

mission: Provide professional service through clear assessment, practical solutions and cost-conscious planning.
vision: Be a trusted service partner for the care and upkeep of homes and facilities.

stp.heading: Treat building wastewater on site
stp.body: An STP treats sewage from a building before discharge through a suitable outlet. Oceanides coordinates the assessment, technical proposal and specialist delivery.
stp.qualification: Suitability depends on wastewater volume, available space, outlet requirements and operating costs. Capacity, treatment performance and maintenance follow the agreed technical proposal. Sludge removal and equipment care continue after installation.

procurement: Share your supplier requirements so we can coordinate company documents and project information for your review.

callToAction.heading: Arrange a site assessment
callToAction.body: Tell us the service you need, the property location and your preferred inspection schedule. We will coordinate the assessment and prepare a quotation based on the findings.
callToAction.scopeNote: Final scope, pricing and scheduling depend on the site assessment and agreed quotation.
